CalendarEarlyClose.description: One calendar date on which trading closes earlier than usual.
CalendarEarlyClose.title: CalendarEarlyClose

CatalogInstrumentsRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated instrument catalogue request.

GET requires only ``instrument_ref``; LIST permits only paging; UPSERT
requires only ``instrument_version`` plus an optional ``expected_version``;
DELETE requires ``instrument_ref`` and ``expected_version``.
CatalogInstrumentsRequest.title: CatalogInstrumentsRequest

CatalogueExchangePackage.description:
One versioned interchange package of catalogue definitions.

Every reference carried by the packaged records must either resolve to a
record inside the package (instruments, sessions, calendars) or appear
in ``external_refs``; providers, brokers, and cost models are never
packaged, so their identifiers must always be declared external.
CatalogueExchangePackage.title: CatalogueExchangePackage

CatalogueFailure.description: Structured failure envelope for every catalogue capability.
CatalogueFailure.title: CatalogueFailure

CostModelRef.description: Reference to one versioned trading cost model.
CostModelRef.title: CostModelRef

CurrencyConversionPath.description: One directed, continuous FX conversion path with its product rate.
CurrencyConversionPath.title: CurrencyConversionPath

DefineSessionsRequest.title: DefineSessionsRequest

DefineSessionsSuccess.description: Successful session and calendar operation result.
DefineSessionsSuccess.title: DefineSessionsSuccess

DefineTradingRulesRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated trading rules and costs request.

UPSERT requires only ``rule_set``; GET requires identity and time;
NORMALIZE requires identity and time plus at least ``price`` or
``quantity``.
DefineTradingRulesRequest.title: DefineTradingRulesRequest

DefineTradingRulesSuccess.description: Successful trading rules and costs operation result.
DefineTradingRulesSuccess.title: DefineTradingRulesSuccess

EffectiveInterval.description:
Half-open effective UTC interval returned by session previews.

This is the inline ``{from_at, to_at}`` record of
``DefineSessionsSuccess.effective_intervals``; it is not one of the 18
registered public records.
EffectiveInterval.title: EffectiveInterval

ExchangeCatalogueRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated catalogue interchange request.

EXPORT forbids ``package``; VALIDATE_IMPORT and IMPORT require it.
ExchangeCatalogueRequest.title: ExchangeCatalogueRequest

FxRateObservation.description: One observed FX quote edge with a freshness deadline.
FxRateObservation.title: FxRateObservation

InstrumentRef.description: Reference to one canonical instrument identity.
InstrumentRef.title: InstrumentRef

InstrumentVersion.description:
One immutable canonical instrument version.

Effective validity is half-open; ``effective_to`` must be strictly after
``effective_from`` when present.
InstrumentVersion.title: InstrumentVersion

ManageUniversesRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated universe management request.

UPSERT requires only ``universe_version``; GET requires only
``universe_ref``; RESOLVE_MEMBERS requires ``universe_ref`` and time.
ManageUniversesRequest.title: ManageUniversesRequest

MapProvidersRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated provider and broker mapping request.

UPSERT/DELETE require ``mapping`` and forbid resolution fields; RESOLVE
requires ``provider``, ``provider_symbol``, and ``as_of`` and forbids
``mapping``.
MapProvidersRequest.title: MapProvidersRequest

MapProvidersSuccess.description: Successful provider and broker mapping operation result.
MapProvidersSuccess.title: MapProvidersSuccess

MarketCalendarVersion.description:
One immutable version of a market calendar.

``holiday_dates`` and ``early_closes`` must each be sorted and unique by
date.
MarketCalendarVersion.title: MarketCalendarVersion

OrderConstraints.description: Executable quantity bounds and supported order mechanics.
OrderConstraints.title: OrderConstraints

ProviderRef.description: Reference to one external data provider identity.
ProviderRef.title: ProviderRef

ProviderSymbolMapping.description:
One versioned provider/broker symbol mapping for an instrument.

The provider/broker/symbol plus effective interval is unique and mappings
may not overlap; that cross-record invariant is enforced by the owning
store because it spans multiple mapping records.
ProviderSymbolMapping.title: ProviderSymbolMapping

TradingInterval.description:
One weekday-localized trading interval inside a session template.

An interval whose close time is before its open time spans into the next
local day; equal open and close times are invalid.
TradingInterval.title: TradingInterval

TradingRuleSet.description: One versioned set of rounding and cost rules for an instrument.
TradingRuleSet.title: TradingRuleSet

TradingSessionDefinition.description:
One versioned, timezone-aware reusable trading session.

Intervals may not overlap after normalizing overnight spans into the
local week (a Sunday-night interval wraps into Monday).
TradingSessionDefinition.title: TradingSessionDefinition

UniverseMembership.description: One timebound membership row of an instrument in a universe.
UniverseMembership.title: UniverseMembership

UniverseVersion.description:
One immutable version of a named universe and its memberships.

Member intervals must intersect the universe interval, and memberships
of one instrument version may not carry overlapping intervals.
UniverseVersion.title: UniverseVersion
